title: Integration-Bench Verdict (v1)
description: Canonical shape of the JSON emitted by bench.verdict.Verdict.to_dict() (docs/SPEC.md §5, §6). ADDITIVE-ONLY RULE: within major schema_version 1, the only permitted changes are additive ones (new optional properties, new optional keys inside existing objects). Any change that removes a required property, renames one, narrows a type, or otherwise breaks a v1 reader MUST bump schema_version to 2 and ship a verdict.v2.json. Because additive-only holds, this schema deliberately does NOT set additionalProperties:false at the top level or on nested objects: a v1 reader must tolerate keys it does not recognize.

schema_version.description: Major version of this verdict contract. Constant 1 for everything described by this file. Consumers should read this first and branch on it before interpreting any other field.

task.description: Task identifier this verdict was produced for (e.g. 'task-0001').

run_id.description: Opaque per-run identifier. Excluded from structural equality by the flake gate (conduct-rules.md gate 3).

resolved.description: True iff error is null AND all L1 checks ok AND all L2 hard checks ok AND all L3 checks ok (L3 is vacuously ok when empty).

l2.description: Level-2 checks, split into hard gates and soft (scored) checks.

hard.description: Hard L2 gates. Any failure forces resolved=false.

soft.description: Soft L2 checks. Do not affect resolved; contribute to a 0..1 score. 'results' is an additive per-check detail array beyond the minimal {violations, checks, score} contract.

violations.description: Number of soft checks that failed (ok == false).

checks.description: Total number of soft checks recorded.

score.description: 1 - violations/checks; 1.0 when there are no soft checks.

results.description: Per-check detail for every soft check.

l3.description: Level-3 (resilience / behavioral) checks. Empty array is vacuously ok.

error.description: Null on a normally-produced verdict; a human-readable string when the run failed to produce checks (e.g. patch did not apply). A non-null error forces resolved=false.

detail.description: Optional human-readable explanation; empty string when there is nothing to say.
